title: Confirm partner adoption + collect a learner use report
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). Partner adoption confirmed in writing, with a learner use report, is the true Definition of Shipped for the entire project. Without it, 'verifiedNeed' remains false and the project has not yet met its beneficiary outcome. This task is the real M4 critical path.
objective: Secure written adoption confirmation from at least one education partner; collect a use report describing how the curriculum was used and what learner-gain feedback was gathered; update verifiedNeed to true upon written confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 1 education partner confirms adoption in writing (email, letter, or signed agreement).

A use report is collected from the partner documenting: how the curriculum was used (context, number of learners, sessions), learner-gain feedback (did learners demonstrate they could do something they could not before?), and any issues or suggestions.
verifiedNeed is updated to true in all relevant task JSON files upon written partner confirmation.
At least 1 external reuse of the CC-BY corpus is documented (a course, offline pack, or downstream app citing the corpus).
output: A committed document containing written partner adoption confirmation, the learner use report, and documentation of at least one external reuse of the CC-BY corpus.
